questions.q: What does topic modeling do with a collection of documents?
options: Predicts a label for each document using labeled training examples
Proposes a small set of themes, each a weighted list of words, and how much each document uses each theme, without labels
Translates each document into another language
Removes stop words and punctuation from the text
questions.explain: Topic modeling is unsupervised: it factors the document-term matrix into topic-word and document-topic weights without needing any labels.

questions.q: In the lesson's NMF example, what does the argument n_components=3 control?
options: The number of words kept in each document
The number of documents in the corpus
The number of topics the model will look for, which you choose
The number of iterations the solver runs
questions.explain: n_components is the number of topics. The model does not discover the right number on its own, so you try several values and read the results.

questions.q: Which input pairing did the lesson use for the two scikit-learn topic models?
options: NMF on TF-IDF weights and LDA on raw word counts
NMF on raw counts and LDA on TF-IDF weights
Both on one-hot encoded characters
Both on pretrained word embeddings
questions.explain: NMF pairs naturally with TF-IDF, while LDA is a probabilistic model of word counts, so it is fit on a CountVectorizer matrix.

questions.q: The NMF model returned three numbered topics. Who decides that topic 1 (charged, card, refund, invoice) means billing?
options: The NMF algorithm assigns names automatically
scikit-learn looks the label up in a dictionary
A human reading the top words and judging what the theme is
The TF-IDF vectorizer
questions.explain: Topic models output numbered word lists. Naming and judging whether a topic is meaningful is a human interpretation step.

questions.q: On the tiny 22-message corpus, refitting LDA with a different random_state changed the topics. What is the best takeaway?
options: The library is broken and should not be used
Topics are exploratory, so check stability across seeds and use more text before trusting them
The random seed should always be set to zero to guarantee correct topics
LDA can only be used with exactly two topics
questions.explain: Small corpora give unstable LDA topics. Refit with several seeds, keep themes that keep appearing, and use more data for reliable results.
